1. Sufficient historical demand data (132 working days)
2. Relatively stable lead time pattern (CV=0.570)
3. Non-zero demand in 100.0% of periods
4. Standard normal distribution assumptions valid for Moderately skewed pattern

service level target (z-score=1.645).
